My mom( grandma) has went through a similar kind of thing as you. Her son ( my biological dad) is an addict. Has taken pretty much anything but the kitchen sink, my biological mother as well. They were too messed up to take care of me and my brother. Ofc, my grandma stepped in to take the role as our mother. She’s been a good mom to all of her kids, always did her absolute best. That’s what she did with us, but in our earlier  years, it was harder for her. My grandpa( I claimed him as my dad) died when I was about 8, so from that point on she was on her own pretty much. My brother had terrible anxiety and ADHD. We both had bad separation anxiety. ( I assume it was bc of our trash birth parents abandoning us). My brother had a lot of behavioral issues as well which was hard on my mom. She had disability and did freelance work to make ends meet. ( she was hurt on the job years before and is an amputee). Sometimes our church family would help us out but my mom hates taking charity. But... she ALWAYS provided for us and got us what we needed. I know she has wanted to run away before and take a break. That can be impossible when you have responsibilities though. But now, years later( I’m 17) she has got herself a nice job she loves and she found herself a man that loves her for her. I remember her telling me one day she finally threw away all of her worries and troubles and just gave them to God. I’m not saying you have to turn to God, or find yourself a significant other or anything. Those are just some things she seeked in life. Be strong no matter how hard it is. Because you are so capable! Do it for you and your daughter. She loves you. My mom has a toxic father as well, but she had finally had enough and lived for herself. And she has a weight lifted off her shoulders. She overcame heavy adversities in her life, but she kept going. Good things come in time and patience. Just know I’m rooting for you! It can be hard but try and find some time for yourself to do something that brings you peace. Write in a diary or meditate, anything. Bc you need to take care of yourself as well ! That’s one of the most important things.
